Description: Sixnine CPU host only. No application bootstrap, credentials, DNS or GPU resources. Review cost and restore plan before deployment.

ref.has: region and cost evidence, release constraints and retention risks

must: CPU only; no credentials, DNS mutation or GPU creation
Review retained resources separately before stopping billing

Sixnine.RetentionWarning: Retained instance and IP can continue billing after stack deletion. Local database/media require separate consistent backups.

InstanceName.Description: A new reviewed instance name; do not reuse an existing workload name.

AvailabilityZone.Description: Confirm availability through Lightsail GetRegions with includeAvailabilityZones=true.

Capacity.Description: Explicit capacity choice: 8GiB/2vCPU for control plane or 16GiB/4vCPU for initial CPU work. No GPU.

KeyPairName.Description: Existing regional Lightsail key-pair NAME; never private key content.

AdminIpv4Cidr.Description: One approved public administrator or fixed runner IPv4 address /32. Never 0.0.0.0/0.

DailySnapshot.Description: Separately billed disk snapshots; not a consistent application backup or an off-account backup.

Assertions.AssertDescription: This reviewed bundle mapping is only for Singapore or Sydney.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Keep the initial private database and application together; separate GPU workers scale independently.
must: SSH limited to the confirmed administrator address
Preserve local database and media before replacement
Use a reviewed regional offer and existing public key pair

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Keep the DNS target stable across ordinary host restarts.
must: Attach to one reviewed host only
Retained detached IP can continue billing

StaticIpv4.Description: Proposed DNS A record target only; template does not change DNS.

SiteUrl.Description: Intended public URL, not evidence that the site is online.
